name: Suwa Mamoru
source:
A detective for the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department Criminal Investigation Division. He is [url=/c4666]Ban[/url]'s junior, and Ban considers him to be both an underling and a friend. His hobby is watching movies, especially Spark Wars.

[spoiler]He is the other perpetrator of New Generation murders along with [url=/c4663]"Grimm"[/url].[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chaos;Head]Wikipedia[/url]]
